purpose: Unchanged fresh CURRENT transfer control with a named Generator and ordinary Fiber callback.
source:
<?php
function Work60Control() {
    echo 'BODY|';
    $reply = Fiber::suspend('pause60');
    echo 'REPLY|', (int) ($reply === 'go60'), '|';
    yield 'value60';
    echo 'END|';
    return 60;
}
function Run60Control() {
    global $g;
    echo 'CALL|';
    return $g->current();
}
$g = Work60Control();
$f = new Fiber('Run60Control');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause60'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|';
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume('go60') === null), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'value60'), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 60), '|';
unset($g, $f);
echo 'E';

purpose: A primed direct named Generator receives the same supplied Exception in catch, suspends, keeps its old cached value and single reentry Error, then yields a new value on Fiber resume.
source:
<?php
function Work60Caught() {
    global $given;
    try {
        echo 'SEED|';
        yield 'seed60';
        echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
    } catch (Exception $caught) {
        echo 'CAUGHT|', (int) ($caught === $given), '|';
        $reply = Fiber::suspend('pause60');
        echo 'REPLY|', (int) ($reply === 'go60'), '|';
        yield 'after60';
        echo 'AFTER-YIELD|';
    } finally {
        echo 'FIN|';
    }
    return 60;
}
function Run60Caught() {
    global $g, $given;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $value = $g->throw($given);
    echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($value === 'after60'), '|';
    return 'fiber60';
}
$given = new Exception('given60');
$g = Work60Caught();
echo 'PRIME|', (int) ($g->current() === 'seed60'), '|';
$f = new Fiber('Run60Caught');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause60'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|', (int) ($g->current() === 'seed60'), '|';
try {
    $g->next();
    echo 'BAD-REENTRY|';
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo 'ERROR|', (int) ($error->getMessage() === 'Cannot resume an already running generator'),
         '|', (int) ($error->getPrevious() === null), '|';
}
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume('go60') === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber60'), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 60), '|';
unset($g, $f, $given, $error);
echo 'E';

purpose: A primed direct named Generator carries its supplied Exception into a suspended finally; Fiber::throw replaces it with Previous identity while the cached object survives until Generator release.
source:
<?php
class Token60 { public function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
function Work60Finally() {
    try {
        echo 'SEED|';
        yield new Token60();
        echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
    } finally {
        echo 'FIN|';
        Fiber::suspend('pause60');
        echo 'BAD-FIN|';
    }
}
function Run60Finally() {
    global $g, $given, $stop;
    echo 'CALL|';
    try {
        $g->throw($given);
        echo 'BAD-RETURN|';
    } catch (Throwable $outside) {
        echo 'OUTSIDE|', (int) ($outside === $stop), '|',
             (int) ($outside->getPrevious() === $given), '|';
    }
    return 'fiber60';
}
$given = new Exception('given60');
$stop = new RuntimeException('stop60');
$g = Work60Finally();
$copy = $g->current();
$weak = WeakReference::create($copy);
unset($copy);
$f = new Fiber('Run60Finally');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause60'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
echo 'INJECT|', (int) ($f->throw($stop) === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber60'), '|';
echo 'CACHE|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
unset($g, $f);
echo 'DROP|', (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
unset($weak, $given, $stop);
echo 'E';

purpose: A pending supplied Exception survives normal Fiber resume through finally with original identity and null Previous; the cached object remains owned until Generator release.
source:
<?php
class Token60Review { public function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
function Work60Pending() {
    try {
        echo 'SEED|';
        yield new Token60Review();
        echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
    } finally {
        echo 'FIN|';
        Fiber::suspend('pause60');
        echo 'AFTER-FIN|';
    }
}
function Run60Pending() {
    global $g, $given;

    try {
        $g->throw($given);
        echo 'BAD-RETURN|';
    } catch (Throwable $outside) {
        echo 'OUTSIDE|', (int) ($outside === $given), '|',
             (int) ($outside->getPrevious() === null), '|';
    }
    return 'fiber60';
}
$given = new Exception('given60');
$g = Work60Pending();
$copy = $g->current();
$weak = WeakReference::create($copy);
unset($copy);
$f = new Fiber('Run60Pending');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause60'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) ($f->isSuspended()), '|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume() === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber60'), '|';

echo 'E';
